title: TabTune: A Unified Library for Inference and Fine-Tuning Tabular Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in predictions across gender/sex groups by calculating Statistical Parity Difference (SPD), Equalized Odds Difference (EOD), and Equalized Opportunity Difference (EOpD) on benchmark tabular datasets (e.g., Adult Census Income, COMPAS, German Credit).

Measuring differences in positive prediction rates and true positive rate parity across race and ethnicity attributes using standard fairness metrics (SPD, EOD, EOpD) on datasets such as Adult Census, COMPAS, and HMDA.

Assessing algorithmic bias across different age groups by computing absolute differences in demographic parity and equalized odds on datasets like German Credit, Adult Census Income, and NHANES Demographics.

Computing systematic bias in predictions across socioeconomic indicators like education level, marital status, and parental level of education using fairness evaluation metrics (SPD, EOD, EOpD) on relevant tabular datasets.
